goal: Iske baad aap structs ka array declare kar sakte hain, usay loop se bhar sakte hain, table print kar sakte hain, kisi member se search kar sakte hain, sab se bari value dhoond sakte hain aur records ko kisi ek member ke hisab se sort kar sakte hain.
warmup: UMT ki class ka attendance register ek table hota hai. Har row ek student hai jis mein roll number, naam aur CGPA hota hai. Ek struct variable ek row hai. Structs ka array poora register hai: row 0, row 1, row 2, aur isi tarah aage. Kisi student ko dhoondne ke liye aap roll-number wale column mein neeche dekhte hain. Merit list banane ke liye aap rows ko CGPA wale column ke hisab se sort karte hain.
definition: Array of structures aisa array hai jis ke elements structs hon. Student list[50]; 50 Student records banata hai. list[i] poora record number i hai (0 se ginti). list[i].name us record ka ek member hai. Arrays ke baare mein jo kuch aap ne seekha (index 0 se, loops, searching, sorting) sab ab bhi chalta hai. Bas itna farq hai ke aap ek member compare ya print karte hain, jaise list[i].cgpa.
howItWorks: Pehle struct declare karein, phir array: Student list[N];. Isay teen tareeqon mein se kisi ek se bharein: initialiser list jis mein har record ke liye ek brace group ho, loop jis mein cin >> list[i].id >> list[i].name >> list[i].cgpa ho, ya ek ek member ki assignments. Table print karne ke liye loop use karein aur members ke beech \t (tab) rakhein. id se search karne ke liye records par loop chalayein aur list[i].id == target test karein. Match ka index ek variable mein rakhein aur usay -1 se shuru karein, jis ka matlab hai not found. Sab se bari CGPA dhoondne ke liye wohi karein jo array ke max ke liye kiya tha (Week 4): farz karein record 0 sab se behtar hai, phir list[i].cgpa ko list[best].cgpa se compare karein aur index yaad rakhein. Sort karne ke liye Week 5 ka bubble sort ya selection sort use karein, lekin us member ko compare karein jis par sort karna hai, maslan list[j].cgpa < list[j + 1].cgpa. POORE records swap karein: Student t = list[j]; list[j] = list[j + 1]; list[j + 1] = t;. Ek swap id, naam aur cgpa ko saath le jata hai, is liye student ka data kabhi mix nahi hota. Parallel arrays ke muqable mein yeh bari jeet hai. Yaad rakhein: aap list.name nahi likh sakte, kyunke list poora array hai. Aur aap do records ko < ya == se compare nahi kar sakte, is liye hamesha member ka naam likhein.
